### Laughter Is Good Medicine
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/laughter-is-good-medicine-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Proverbs 17:22
Points:
- Unavoidable life trials can easily wear down the human spirit.
- Cultivating a joyful heart brings genuine spiritual and physical resilience.
- Laughter serves as a God-given gift that eases tension and restores perspective.
- Dwelling in chronic despair depletes vitality and harms well-being.
- Choosing cheerfulness honors God's goodness and extends hope to others.

### Trusting God with Your Friendships
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/trusting-god-with-your-friendships.html
Passage: Proverbs 17:17
Points:
- Faithful friends act as chosen family who stand firm during hardship.
- Sustaining deep relationships requires intentionality, patience, and ongoing grace.
- Life transitions and shifting priorities can complicate maintaining close bonds.
- Cultivating healthy connections often calls for establishing wise boundaries.
- Attracting dependable, loving companions begins with striving to be one yourself.

### Discerning Rebuke
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/discerning-rebuke
Passage: Proverbs 17:9-10
Points:
- Spoken words possess great power either to ruin friendships or build up others.
- Genuine love covers minor personal offenses rather than repeatedly dredging them up.
- Continually replaying past grievances or spreading gossip fractures close relationships.
- A discerning person readily hears and learns from constructive criticism.
- Stubborn fools refuse correction, whereas wise individuals grow through thoughtful rebuke.
